snippet.title: ShipShaper | Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
ShipShaper Sets Sail for Steam Early Access on September 2nd! 

ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license. 

Created by Solo Developer Tomas Sala - there is no combat, management or prescribed way to build. No intimidating 3D tools, rigid grids or correct answers. Players simply pull, push, bend and shape forms into fishing vessels, tall ships, ironclads, submarines or glorious nautical creations no sensible shipyard would ever approve. 

Early Access expands the current demo with : 
- The ability to take creations onto the water and sail them.
- New historical weapons and turrets, propulsion options, sail types, lighting, props.
- More flexible shaping tools. 

Once a vessel is ready to leave the shipyard, players can admire it bobbing on the horizon, place it inside a bottle or handcrafted diorama, export it into Bulwark: Falconeer Chronicles or take the complete 3D model into another creative project. Models can also be exported and prepared for 3D printing using external software, depending on the design and printing method. 

ShipShaper’s free commercial licence allows developers, modders, makers and other creators to use their designs in personal and commercial projects. Models are already appearing in small independent games. 

Play the demo now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4339280/ShipShaper/
